title: Transport of an objectwise mate identity to diagrams
statement: Let $L:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, $P:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $T:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$, $U:\mathcal C\to\mathcal A$, $R:\mathcal E\to\mathcal A$, $Q:\mathcal A\to\mathcal E$ be functors with adjunctions $a:L\dashv P$, $a_R:R\dashv Q$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. Let $c:T\circ R\simeq L\circ U$ and $B:P\circ T\to U\circ Q$ (diagrammatic composition) satisfy $T(\eta^a_N) B_{LN}=\eta^{a_R}_{TN}Q(c_N)$ for every $N\in\mathcal D$. Let $G,G_0,H,H_0$ be diagrams indexed by $\mathbf N^{op}$ in $\mathcal D,\mathcal E,\mathcal C,\mathcal A$, respectively, with $h_G:G_0=G\circ T$, $\beta:G\circ L\simeq H$, and $e:H\circ U\simeq H_0$. Then there exist $\beta_0:G_0\circ R\simeq H_0$ and $t:(H\circ P)\circ T\to H_0\circ Q$. The map $t$ equals the whiskered $B$ followed by $Q(e)$, and for every level $n$, $h_{G,n}T(\eta^a_{G_n}P(\beta_n))t_n=\eta^{a_R}_{G_{0,n}}Q(\beta_{0,n})$. No invertibility assumption on $B$ is required.

source.place: Adjunction mate construction; Tag 0B65 for naturality and conjugation

proof.text: Construct beta zero by composing R(eqToIso hG), G(c), U(beta) and e. Construct t as H(B) followed by Q(e), so its normalization equality is reflexive. Evaluate at n and expand the component of beta zero and t. Functoriality expands T of the composite unit and beta. Naturality of B at beta moves beta after B at L(G_n). Substitute the given objectwise mate identity. Naturality of the R-adjunction unit at eqToHom hG moves this component to Q(R(-)) following the new unit. Functoriality of Q and associativity identify the result with Q(beta zero_n). These steps are recorded in the private proved helper exchange_unit, followed by the component formula for beta zero.

proof_origin.place: Naturality and functoriality of the mate construction; explicit diagram transport

theorem formal_system_exchange_mate_compatibility
    {C D E A : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E] [Category A]
    (L : D ⥤ C) (P : C ⥤ D) (T : D ⥤ E) (U : C ⥤ A)
    (R : E ⥤ A) (Q : A ⥤ E) (adj : L ⊣ P) (adjR : R ⊣ Q)
    (c : T ⋙ R ≅ L ⋙ U) (B : P ⋙ T ⟶ U ⋙ Q)
    (hmate : ∀ N : D, T.map (adj.unit.app N) ≫ B.app (L.obj N) =
      adjR.unit.app (T.obj N) ≫ Q.map (c.hom.app N))
    (G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ D) (G₀ : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ E) (hG : G₀ = G ⋙ T)
    (H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ C) (H₀ : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (β : G ⋙ L ≅ H) (e : H ⋙ U ≅ H₀) :
    ∃ (β₀ : G₀ ⋙ R ≅ H₀) (t : (H ⋙ P) ⋙ T ⟶ H₀ ⋙ Q),
      t = Functor.whiskerLeft H B ≫ Functor.whiskerRight e.hom Q ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, (eqToHom hG).app (op n) ≫
          T.map (adj.unit.app (G.obj (op n)) ≫ P.map (β.hom.app (op n))) ≫
            t.app (op n) =
        adjR.unit.app (G₀.obj (op n)) ≫ Q.map (β₀.hom.app (op n)))
